title: Agrona copies cursor-backed map entries into arrays
summary: Both array overloads returned one cursor three times on each of the four parent maps. Every merged array held all three original pairs as distinct entries of the requested array type. The three merged entries compared equal to their JDK counterparts but all hashed to 11. HashSet found 1=10 and missed 2=20 and 3=30.

change.description: The entry sets snapshot each pair when converting an allocation-avoiding map to an array.

notes: The backing map remains unchanged. Pair multisets are sorted only after the conversions finish. Reference hashes from SimpleImmutableEntry were 11, 22 and 29.
